productFit.name: Fatboy Traverse 2 Section Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: 42,5 mm leg tubes, 47,5 mm rubber feet (maker gives only these in mm)
productFit.reason: FatBoy's dealer list shows dealers in the US, Canada and Australia, none in Germany, Spain, the Netherlands or Belgium; the maker's own shop has an international checkout. Neutral note: mainly sold in the US through FatBoy and US dealers.

productFit.name: Warrior Tripods The Commander
productFit.reason: Warrior sells from its US shop with US prices; I found no European dealer or EU retailer listing. Neutral note: mainly sold in the US.

productFit.name: Vortex Radian Carbon Tripod Kit
productFit.metricSpecs: German seller: ball head kit 25 kg max. load (leveling head kit 20 kg)
productFit.reason: Sold by EU retailers under the same name, e.g. LSEK Industries (Germany) as "Vortex Radian Carbon Stativ Kit" with Kugelkopf or Nivellierkopf, and MilStore (Austria).

productFit.name: BOG DeathGrip Infinite Carbon Fiber Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: all4shooters measured (not maker): 2925 g, 78 cm packed, clamp about 150 cm high at 20 deg; counterweight hook max. 11,4 kg (25 lb); tube diameters about 35,4/31,8/28,2 mm
productFit.reason: Sold in the EU as "DeathGrip Infinite Tripod Carbon Fiber" by the Czech online retailer STROBL.CZ; all4shooters (European hunting magazine) reviewed it from that range.

productFit.name: SLIK Pro 700 DX Tripod Legs
productFit.variant: SLIK Global (Japan) lists the PRO 700DX as a kit with the 3-way PRO 700DX HEAD: 1900 mm max with column, 760 mm folded, 3670 g total (legs 2670 g), first leg tube 30,2 mm. The legs-only set (ASIN B001B2I9L8) is a SLIK USA listing; keep the English legs-only figures (converted) in the post.
productFit.metricSpecs: SLIK USA legs only: 1795 mm max, 700 mm folded, 2510 g
productFit.reason: Outside the US SLIK presents the 700DX mainly as a full kit with head; the legs-only set is the US version. Product stays as in the English post.

localFacts.fact: FBE Fryslan: Provincie Fryslan granted an exemption (ontheffing) for controlling foxes at night with artificial light and/or night vision equipment to protect meadow birds, valid 1 December to 30 June; extended on 8 April 2026 until 30 June 2028. Rules differ per province.
CBS: men aged 20 or older in the Netherlands were on average 1,81 m tall in 2018; Fatboy (182 cm) reaches that on the legs, Warrior (180 cm) almost.
all4shooters measured the BOG DeathGrip Infinite CF at 2925 g and 78 cm packed, clamp about 150 cm high at full extension; sold in the EU by STROBL.CZ.
A German seller lists the Vortex Radian Carbon ball head kit at 25 kg max. load (leveling head kit 20 kg).
Local terms: schietstok (driepoot), tripod, balhoofd, nivelleerbasis, Arca-Swiss-rail, vossenbestrijding, aanzit.

localPainPoints.pain: A tripod shooting stick has to stand firm before you lean on it.
localPainPoints.fix: Press the feet in (spikes out on frozen or muddy ground), legs wide, then test with light pressure before the rifle goes on.

quotes.text: De ondersteuning installeert u eenvoudig door deze eerst stevig in de grond te nestelen

localPainPoints.pain: Changing height by moving the legs closer or wider changes stability.
localPainPoints.fix: Reach shooting height on the thickest sections at the widest stop that still works; do not narrow the legs or use the centre column for height.

quotes.text: Pas de hoogte van een driebenige-schietstok aan door de benen verder uit elkaar of juist dichter bij elkaar te plaatsen.
